name: pydatamaster
description: PyDataMaster i.o. - interactive Python data-science learning platform with admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
